license_required.quote: Any person who shall practice, or shall in any manner hold himself out to any other person, or to the public, as qualified or licensed to practice dentistry, or who represents himself to be a dentist, within the state of Idaho, without at the time thereof being a dentist, shall be guilty of a misdemeanor

issuing_authority.quote: the board shall have the following powers and duties: (1) To ascertain the qualifications and fitness of applicants to practice dentistry

name.quote: "Board" means the state board of dentistry

type.quote: the state board of dentistry as established in chapter 9, title 54, Idaho Code

umbrella_agency.value: Division of Occupational and Professional Licenses
umbrella_agency.quote: There is hereby created in the division of occupational and professional licenses the Idaho allied health advisory board

moral_character_required.quote: No person hereafter shall be eligible for licensure to practice dentistry, dental therapy, or dental hygiene in this state unless the applicant: (1) Has not been convicted, found guilty, or received a withheld judgment or a suspended sentence

degree_required.value: Doctor of Dental Surgery or Doctor of Dental Medicine
degree_required.quote: Shall, for dentistry, have successfully completed the course of study in dentistry, and graduated and received a degree of doctor of dental surgery or doctor of dental medicine from a dental school accepted and approved by the board

accrediting_body.value: Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association
accrediting_body.quote: The applicant has graduated from a dental school accredited by the commission on dental accreditation of the American dental association as of the date of the applicant's graduation

exams.name: National Board Dental Examination
exams.quote: the board may require and accept the results of the national board dental and dental hygiene examinations administered by the American dental association

exams.name: Board-approved clinical examination
exams.quote: In lieu of conducting clinical examinations, the board may require and accept the results of clinical examinations administered by national or regional testing organizations approved by the board

exams.name: Jurisprudence examination
exams.quote: An applicant for licensure shall pass the written jurisprudence examination conducted by the board. A passing score of seventy-five percent (75%) correct shall be required on the written jurisprudence examination

interval_years.quote: To renew a dental license, each licensee shall submit a properly completed renewal application and the appropriate biennial license fee to the board prior to September 30 of every even-numbered calendar year

renewal_fee_usd.quote: Four hundred dollars ($400) for a dentist with an active status

available.quote: The board may issue a license to practice dentistry without further examination upon evidence that: (1) The applicant currently holds an active license in good standing to practice dentistry in another state

requirements.value: Five years of clinical practice with minimum 3,500 hours, graduation from ADA-accredited dental school, successful completion of national board dental examinations, and successful completion of board-approved clinical examination
requirements.quote: The applicant has been in clinical practice at least five (5) years immediately preceding the date of application for a minimum of three thousand five hundred (3,500) hours; (3) The applicant has graduated from a dental school accredited by the commission on dental accreditation of the American dental association as of the date of the applicant's graduation; (4) The applicant has successfully completed the national board dental examinations; (5) The applicant has successfully completed a board-approved clinical examination

exists.quote: the state board of dentistry as established in chapter 9, title 54, Idaho Code

national_association.quote: the commission on dental accreditation of the American dental association

regulatory_model.quote: Any person who shall practice, or shall in any manner hold himself out to any other person, or to the public, as qualified or licensed to practice dentistry, or who represents himself to be a dentist, within the state of Idaho, without at the time thereof being a dentist, shall be guilty of a misdemeanor

credential_type.quote: Upon the candidate's request, the board will issue to each passing applicant in dentistry, who is qualified for Idaho licensure, a certificate of qualification to practice dentistry

is_mandatory.quote: Any person who shall practice, or shall in any manner hold himself out to any other person, or to the public, as qualified or licensed to practice dentistry, or who represents himself to be a dentist, within the state of Idaho, without at the time thereof being a dentist, shall be guilty of a misdemeanor

title_protection.quote: Any person who shall practice, or shall in any manner hold himself out to any other person, or to the public, as qualified or licensed to practice dentistry, or who represents himself to be a dentist, within the state of Idaho, without at the time thereof being a dentist, shall be guilty of a misdemeanor

scope_protection.quote: The practice of dentistry is the doing by one (1) person, for a direct or indirect consideration, of one (1) or more of the following with respect to the teeth, gums, alveolar process, jaws, or adjacent tissues of another person

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentionally misstating or failing to disclose material facts in application or cheating in examination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Intentionally misstate or fail fully to disclose a fact material to determination of fitness and qualification in an application for licensure to practice dentistry or cheat in an examination to practice dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring a certificate or license by false, fraudulent, or deceitful means or under a name other than true name
disciplinary_grounds.quote: procure a certificate or finding of qualification to practice dentistry or subsequently a license by false, fraudulent or deceitful means or in any other name than his own true name

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing dentistry under any name other than true name except as professional service corporation or LLC
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practice dentistry under any name other than his own true name except as a professional service corporation or professional limited liability company

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making fraudulent, false, or misleading statements about skill or method of practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Make, or cause to be made, or assist in making, any fraudulent, false, or misleading statement as to his own or an employee's, associate's, or other dentist's, dental therapist's, or dental hygienist's skill or lack of skill, or method of practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Claiming to practice dentistry without causing pain
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Claim to practice dentistry without causing pain

disciplinary_grounds.description: Publishing or advertising reports, letters, certificates, or evidence of cures by reason of skill or use of systems or methods
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Publish, advertise, or circulate reports, letters, certificates, endorsements, or evidence of cures or corrections of dental conditions by such dentist, his employee, or his associate by reason of his or their skill, experience, or ability

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising use of falsely advertised or misnamed systems, methods, techniques, devices, drugs, or machines
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertise the use of, or use, any system, method, technique, device, drug, medicine, material or machine that is either falsely advertised or misnamed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using intoxicants or drugs to a degree rendering the dentist unfit to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use intoxicants or drugs to such a degree as to render him unfit to practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing dental care that fails to meet the standard of care provided by other qualified dentists in the same community
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commit malpractice, that is, to provide dental care that fails to meet the standard of dental care provided by other qualified dentists in the same community or similar communities

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in unprofessional conduct as defined by board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engage in unprofessional conduct, as defined by board rules

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising in a way that deceives or defrauds the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertise in such way as to deceive or defraud, or probably deceive or defraud, the public or patrons

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing or permitting unlicensed persons to practice dentistry, dental therapy, or dental hygiene in office
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employ or permit any person not a dentist to practice dentistry, or any person not a dentist or dental therapist to practice dental therapy, or any person not a dentist or dental hygienist to practice dental hygiene, in his office or under his control or direction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to keep office or equipment in accordance with state and federal laws and regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fail, neglect or refuse to keep his office or equipment, or otherwise conduct his work, in accordance with current state and federal laws, rules and regulations

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any other provisions of law or rules adopted by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violate any other provisions of law or rules adopted by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsely identifying oneself to the public as a specialist in a specialty area of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Falsely identify himself to the public as a specialist in a specialty area of dentistry as defined by rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in practice as member, stockholder, employee, director, partner or proprietor in business entity where unlicensed person holds ownership interest
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engage in the practice of dentistry as a member, stockholder, employee, director, partner or proprietor in any business entity in which a person, not duly licensed to practice dentistry in this state, holds an ownership interest

disciplinary_grounds.description: Supervising more than three dental therapists
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Supervise more than three (3) dental therapists

disciplinary_grounds.description: Requiring patients to sign agreements limiting their right to file complaints with the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Require directly, or as a member, representative, contracted agent, or employee of or in connection with any company, association, corporation, or partnership, that a patient sign an agreement limiting his right or ability to file a complaint with the board

definition_quote.value: The practice of dentistry is the doing by one (1) person, for a direct or indirect consideration, of one (1) or more of the following with respect to the teeth, gums, alveolar process, jaws, or adjacent tissues of another person, namely: Examining for diagnosis, treatment, extraction, repair, replacement, substitution, or correction; Diagnosing of disease, pain, injury, deficiency, deformity or physical condition; Treating, operating, prescribing, extracting, repairing, taking impressions, fitting, replacing, substituting, or correcting; Administering anesthetics or medicaments in connection with any of the foregoing.
definition_quote.quote: The practice of dentistry is the doing by one (1) person, for a direct or indirect consideration, of one (1) or more of the following with respect to the teeth, gums, alveolar process, jaws, or adjacent tissues of another person, namely: Examining for diagnosis, treatment, extraction, repair, replacement, substitution, or correction; Diagnosing of disease, pain, injury, deficiency, deformity or physical condition; Treating, operating, prescribing, extracting, repairing, taking impressions, fitting, replacing, substituting, or correcting; Administering anesthetics or medicaments in connection with any of the foregoing.

methods_authorized.quote: Examining for diagnosis, treatment, extraction, repair, replacement, substitution, or correction; Diagnosing of disease, pain, injury, deficiency, deformity or physical condition; Treating, operating, prescribing, extracting, repairing, taking impressions, fitting, replacing, substituting, or correcting; Administering anesthetics or medicaments

drug_authority.value: Administering anesthetics or medicaments in connection with dental practice
drug_authority.quote: Administering anesthetics or medicaments in connection with any of the foregoing

specialist_license_available.quote: "Dental specialist" is a dentist who has graduated from a board-approved postgraduate program in the dentist's specialty and is a person both qualified and licensed by the laws of Idaho to practice a dental specialty recognized by the board

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote:
"Direct supervision" is supervision of a dental therapist, dental assistant, or dental hygienist requiring that a dentist diagnose the condition to be treated, that a dentist authorize the procedure to be performed, that a dentist remain in the practice setting while the procedure is performed, and that before dismissal of the patient a dentist approves the work performed by the dental therapist, dental assistant, or dental hygienist.
(10) "Extended access oral health care setting" means and includes:...
(11) "General supervision" is supervision of a dental therapist, dental assistant, or dental hygienist requiring that a dentist authorize the procedure which is carried out, but not requiring that a dentist be in the practice setting when the authorized procedure is performed.
(12) "Indirect supervision" is supervision of a dental therapist, dental assistant, or dental hygienist requiring that a dentist authorize a procedure and that a dentist be in the practice setting while the procedure is performed by the therapist, assistant, or hygienist.

dental_therapist_license_available.quote: "Dental therapist" is a person both qualified and licensed by the laws of Idaho to practice dental therapy

dental_therapist_collaborative_practice_.quote: The practice of dental therapy is the doing by one (1) person for a direct or indirect consideration of one (1) or more of the following with respect to the teeth or dental health of another person, namely, identifying oral and systemic conditions, performing dental prophylaxis, dispensing and administering nonnarcotic analgesics, anti-inflammatory and antibiotic medications as prescribed by a licensed dentist, applying preventive agents, preparation and placement of direct restorations in primary and permanent teeth, indirect and direct pulp capping on permanent teeth, indirect pulp capping on primary teeth, and such other dental services as specified by the supervising dentist

value: discharge of official duties on behalf of the United States government
tribal health programs contracted to perform services on behalf of the United States government
practice setting within the exterior boundaries of a tribal reservation
dental_therapist_practice_setting_restri.quote: such services and procedures shall be limited to the discharge of official duties on behalf of the United States government, including through the United States public health service, the Indian health service, or tribal health programs contracted to perform services on behalf of the United States government in a practice setting within the exterior boundaries of a tribal reservation

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: Engage in the practice of dentistry as a member, stockholder, employee, director, partner or proprietor in any business entity in which a person, not duly licensed to practice dentistry in this state, holds an ownership interest

teledentistry_authorized.quote: A provider delivering health care services via virtual care must at all times act within the scope of the provider's license and according to all applicable laws and rules, including but not limited to this chapter and the Idaho community standard of care
